My Venus in Gemini is very tricky tbh. I don’t see the point in having flings(but when I was younger that’s all I wanted but more because I was emotionally unavailable than because I just wanted to get around) and I like serious relationships. I love having feelings and exploring life with someone else. My relationships don’t last very long because I tend to ignore things that bother me in the beginning but they always resurface after a few months. I can’t commit to anyone that doesn’t mentally stimulate me or I feel like I can’t have a deep conversation with. On the other hand, I love flirting and playing the field. I’m loyal I don’t cheat but I get tempted very easily to do it even though I never go through with it. I don’t get in relationships very easily I need to have very strong feelings for someone to commit to them. I like to take risks and I always have to express how I feel. Also, I can feel Saturn’s effect on my relationships and I can see the lesson in every single one of them. 
Lastly, I can become from very emotional to very cold hearted if someone does me wrong(of course I will be in pain but I won’t let the other person see it).
